title: Sports Medicine
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to distinguish the pathways and requirements for career opportunities within Kinesiology, including Athletic Training.

Upon successful completion of the program, the students will be able to implement an emergency action plan (EAP), including primary and secondary surveys of an injured individual and administration of emergency care procedures.

Upon successful completion of the program, the students will be able to identify blood-borne pathogens, administer basic first aid, and incorporate appropriate splinting and taping techniques for an array of injuries using various medical supplies.

Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to appraise musculoskeletal imbalances that may predispose athletes to injury, interpret sports-related injury information, and communicate that information to various members of the sports medicine team.
Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to design and administer basic injury rehabilitation programs.

notes: The catalog prints course codes without a space (e.g. KINSB1A); these match closed-list codes KINS B1A, KINS B2A, KINS B3A, KINS B3B.
KINSB48WE (Work Experience Education, 4 units) is not in the closed list and is recorded as a catalog addition.
The '(Total 16)' is printed for the Sports Medicine Certificate as a whole and recorded as total_units; the description also calls it a 16 credit certificate. Course units sum to 16.

Each printed outcome begins with 'Upon successful completion of the program, ...' as part of the numbered item itself; this text was kept since it is printed within each outcome rather than as a separate lead-in.
The award level in the request (16S to fewer than 30S units) is consistent with the 16-unit total.
